integrity: All claimed infinite-family conclusions are proved using an integral chain decomposition. The finite checker is only an independent combinatorial and finite-field corroboration. Priority is based on targeted, nonexhaustive comparison; independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The statement is limited to degree-four integral homology, primitive minimum cycle supports, equivariance and inclusions of two-tolerance complexes of disjoint filled triangles; it does not give full homotopy type or other homology dimensions.
title: Integral pair-sphere lattice in two-tolerance complexes of disjoint triangles
